scope: 10 new concept sheets, no Unity modifications

concepts.name: 분할 코어 휘장
concepts.design: An OPEN DIAMOND silhouette made from TWO thick curved ivory/silver chevron pieces separated at top and bottom, enclosing a deep navy diamond plate with a raised teal heart or amber sword. Four broad beveled corners, no shield point, wide negative-space gaps expose the colored core. Looks like a precision collectible crest rather than an UI window. Collection: the two chevrons separate a little, the icon core shrinks into a short colored streak at the sneakers; fading frame pieces remain visible briefly. No mechanical gears.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE landscape 1536x1024 original concept sheet for a premium-looking yet realistically buildable collectible Bonus Wall in Tralalero Shooter.
REFERENCES: Image 1 is the USER-LIKED visual quality reference: navy enamel, satin ivory/silver rims, confident bevels, large relief icons, clean stylized materials and game/detail/pickup sheet composition. Copy its level of polish and consistency, NOT its shield silhouette. Image 2 is the actual game screenshot: use its familiar harbor boardwalk, seafood stalls, bright sea, elevated rear camera and exact gray shark with cyan-white sneakers. Keep environment coherent and recognizable. The shark has TWO feet and a tail ending in a sneaker, not four legs or four shoes.
THE USER REQUEST: ten genuinely diverse directions within the liked visual family. This sheet is one specified direction; its silhouette MUST differ from a shield. Do not default back to shields, ornate shrines or generic rectangular upgrade cards unless explicitly asked in its specific design.
LAYOUT same across series: thin cream/navy top header with exact title supplied below, small right note "제작 시안". Left 55% = large main gameplay panel labelled "게임 안 모습": shark near bottom approaching TWO collectible choices on left/right of the walkable pier. Left health teal, right attack amber; exact compact labels "체력 +13" and "공격력 +14%" beneath objects. Right upper 45% = close-up labelled "형태": BOTH matching objects isolated on warm neutral ivory background, show thickness, bevels, materials. Right lower = gameplay detail labelled "획득": chosen attack reward activating near shark, unused health reward quietly fading, compact "공격력 +14%" only once. No huge HUD, no other explanatory paragraphs. No English title or invented logo.
DESIGN LANGUAGE: strong simple object silhouette, attractive thick beveled edge with satin silver/ivory accent, navy structural body, jewel-like teal health and amber attack accents. Clear HEART / SWORD identifiers. A small sneaker stamp may appear only where appropriate. Material depth comes from broad light reflections, controlled roughness and clean normals, not noisy microdetail. Game-ready stylized rendering with thin dark outlines; not flat crude low-poly blocks, not photoreal or cinematic. Match quality of liked reference.
GAME SIZE: collectible around knee height or lower, occupies clearly less than half of lane; clear gap between pair; small contact shadow below floating objects. No stands/plinths unless specifically required. Stat labels stay unobstructed and do not merge. The game-view and close-up constructions are identical.
BUILDABILITY: each item uses 2-5 simple rigid mesh components or lit icon sprites. Basic mesh extrusion/revolve/bevel, existing stat icons/TMP, ordinary cel-shaded/glow materials. The described collection animation uses rotation, scale, fade, rigid-part movement and at most two thin light ribbons; no fluids, cloth simulation, destructible geometry or complex rig. No claim that an exact finished prefab already exists.
VFX: no arrowheads anywhere, no illustrated direction arrows, no particle star clouds, no smoke, no green poison, no body-obscuring flare. At most a few small non-star light flecks and one thin ground flash. No pillar of light. The acquisition should clearly affect the existing shoes, not create permanent new shoes. Use the specific animation cue, not the exact same effect in every variation.
Avoid gosa tables, pig heads, candles, temple architecture, big gates, signs stretched across the road, dropped wrench/medical kit, generic gold currency coins, angels, new characters and world lore explanations.

concepts.name: 에나멜 능력 인장
concepts.design: A SHORT THICK CIRCULAR SILVER ENAMEL SEAL medallion, slightly domed navy center, a bold raised teal heart / amber sword, three broad rim grooves and a SINGLE small notch cut in the lower rim. Strong round silhouette with convincing thick side wall, no gold coin rim, no currency markings, no chains or stand. Collection: the circular seal rolls one quarter turn and a flat matching colored emblem briefly STAMPS under the sneaker soles; object fades. The ground stamp is small, not a magic circle.

concepts.name: 능력 코어 젬
concepts.design: A LARGE SMOOTH FACETED TEARDROP GEM, teal for heart / amber for attack, semi-opaque polished enamel-crystal material without refraction. A thick SATIN SILVER U-SHAPED OPEN CLIP grips its lower third; a navy inset front face displays a simple IVORY HEART or IVORY SWORD relief. Four or five broad facets, no dense gemstone cuts, no glass orb. Gem floats upright and is attractive even at phone scale. Collection: gem scales down and a brief faceted color glint appears at shoes; clip and gem fade together, no shower of shards.
